role: Entity filter interface plus ready-made selectors (alive, alive and unridden, inventories) used by AI, hoppers and spawn code, and the ArmoredMob filter for equipment pickup.
scope_reason: An interface with no behaviour of its own that runs in this game: the entity filters that matter are anonymous implementations inside their users (EntityAINearestAttackableTarget.java:44, EntityAIAvoidEntity.java:15, IMob.mobSelector), indexed there. Its own static selectors are unreached: selectAnything and field_152785_b have no caller, selectInventories is the hopper's (redstone = off) and ArmoredMob the dispenser's armour behaviour (redstone = off).
notes: The filters it parameterizes are reimplemented inline in the native AI and container code (csrc/engine/ai.c, csrc/engine/container.c); I did not verify each use site maps one to one. Static __OBFID constants are grouped out per the brief. idxaudit 2026-09-27: scope reason rewritten.
